cache_manifest.layer_indexing: 1-based raw transformer-block outputs; final model norm is not applied
cache_manifest.token_ids_layout: flat unpadded input_ids; input_offsets delimit each document

jvp.direction: unit-norm Gaussian; non-final token tangents are zero

training_targets.teacher_compute_dtype: CUDA BF16 autocast prefix; native FP32 selected suffix blocks; FP32 weights, residuals and shared head
training_targets.teacher_extraction_approximation: BF16-prefix/FP32-suffix targets with validated native prefix-KV JVPs; rejected batches regenerate the same hybrid-precision full sequence, not FP32-equivalent targets

teacher_compilation.suffix_derivative_policy_reason: Native prefix-KV mode executes both prefill and vectorized final-token JVPs without torch.compile

teacher_jvp_extraction.direction: unit-norm FP32 Gaussian; doc-major RNG; non-final token tangents zero

cross_shape_primal_check.reduction: all suffix boundaries and hidden coordinates, independently per prompt
cross_shape_primal_check.comparison: ordinary one-query suffix against retained full-prefill raw targets
cross_shape_primal_check.finite_violation: regenerate the same whole batch with full-sequence BF16 JVPs

training_targets.validation_target_precision: Official reference FP32 states and JVPs, unchanged
training_targets.train_target_precision: Canonical prefix-kv: BF16 prefix, FP32 final suffix and JVP; any canonical fallback recorded

layer_indexing: 1-based raw transformer-block outputs; final model norm is not applied
epoch_definition: Fixed accepted-document budget; one persistent shuffled source, never replayed
num_train_docs_definition: Accepted documents per logical epoch, not corpus cardinality
token_hash_definition: SHA-256 of capped unpadded little-endian int64 tokens before crop

crop_protocol.heldout_identity: SHA-256 of capped unpadded little-endian int64 tokens before crop

train_metric_definition: Post-update evaluation of the fixed first min(256, num_train_docs) training documents at the same checkpoint as validation; epoch 0 is initialization.
optimizer: Muon matrix weights x1.5 + Adam biases
learning_rate_definition: Adam base LR; actual Adam and Muon update rates are logged separately

normalization.external_coordinates: raw teacher residual states before final normalization
normalization.reconstruction_objective: plain raw input-state MSE between decode(encode(x0)) and x0; no operator steps
normalization.state_objective: plain elementwise raw-state MSE across all rollout outputs
normalization.latent_objective: plain MSE; propagated and teacher-encoded branches both trainable
normalization.multistart_objective: plain MSE over all later-start/end pairs equally; no propagation resets

metric_definitions.reconstruction_mse: raw input-state reconstruction SSE / (documents * hidden width)
metric_definitions.state_rollout_mse: raw rollout SSE / (documents * output boundaries * hidden width)
metric_definitions.latent_mse: latent SSE / (documents * output boundaries * latent width)
metric_definitions.fvu: summed SSE / (epoch-wide target variation around each feature mean + 1e-8)
metric_definitions.kl_divergence: KL(teacher || student) at the final endpoint, through the frozen norm and head
metric_definitions.train: fixed first training documents, evaluated after updates at the same checkpoint as val
metric_definitions.val: fixed held-out clean cache; test documents are never evaluated during training

gradient_diagnostics.sampling: fixed training-probe batch before each epoch's updates; epoch0 initialization
gradient_diagnostics.raw_norms: per-loss L2 norms, including zero-weight losses
gradient_diagnostics.weighted_norms: loss weight times raw gradient norm
gradient_diagnostics.cosines: unweighted pairwise gradient cosine; zero-norm pairs omitted
gradient_diagnostics.combined_gradient: train/grad_norm_pre_clip: mean update norm before clipping
